verdict.rationale: AMD provides official Ryzen AI SDKs, ONNX Runtime EPs (Vitis AI, DirectML), Quark quantization toolkit, Lemonade SDK, and language bindings (Python/C++/C#/JavaScript) for building LLM and vision AI applications on the NPU/iGPU, plus an open-source GAIA agent framework built on this stack, indicating strong first-party SDK support for AI-native development. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of SDK developer experience and completeness of API reference/OpenAPI docs (probe found no OpenAPI spec).
